Title: Node TLS Certificate Rejection Bypass Risk in Local Mode
Observed: Local adapters fail with DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT exit code 1 when contacting self-signed local proxies/Ollama without CA injection.
Impact: Developers frequently disable TLS verification globally, exposing tokens to MitM attacks on shared networks.
Recommended_Fix: Inject custom CA bundle via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS or provide per-adapter strictSSL: false toggle with warning.
Acceptance_Criteria: Adapter connects over HTTPS with custom root CA without setting global NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0.

Title: Monolithic Route Aggregation in server/src/index.ts
Observed: High coupling; all route handlers, middleware, and websocket lifecycle are defined in a monolithic index file.
Impact: High merge conflict rate, test isolation difficulty, regression risks during feature additions.
Recommended_Fix: Decompose into modular domain routers under server/src/routes/ (auth, agents, tasks, companies, adapters).
Acceptance_Criteria: server/src/index.ts reduced to <200 lines serving as application entry point and router aggregator.

Title: Embedded Postgres PID Lock Collision on Windows Crash
Observed: Post.master.pid remains after abnormal termination, preventing server restart with 'shared memory block' errors.
Impact: Developer onboarding blockage and local daemon unreliability.
Recommended_Fix: Add pre-flight stale PID check and cleanup hook in scripts/dev-runner.ts before initializing embedded postgres.
Acceptance_Criteria: Dev runner cleanly boots even if previous node/postgres process was terminated via SIGKILL.

Title: Linear Pseudo-Collaboration vs Autonomous Multi-Agent Mesh
Observed: Agent collaboration is primarily sequential dispatch via issue threads rather than dynamic peer-to-peer negotiation.
Impact: Complex problem-solving is bottlenecked by orchestrator dispatch rounds and user prompt intervention.
Recommended_Fix: Implement agent contract protocols and pub/sub task bus for autonomous peer-to-peer agent delegation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Agent A can delegate subtasks directly to Agent B with structured response schemas and shared workspace locks.

Title: Unbounded Fallback Cascades and Token Spikes
Observed: Adapter retries on 'adapter_failed' can consume rate limits without strict exponential backoff caps.
Impact: API quota exhaustion and increased token expenditures during upstream service degradations.
Recommended_Fix: Add circuit-breaker pattern with per-provider sliding window failure rates and hard dollar budgets.
Acceptance_Criteria: Circuit opens after 3 consecutive adapter failures, halting automatic retries and notifying user.

Title: Company-Scope Verification Gaps on Multi-Tenant Endpoints
Observed: Certain internal diagnostic and event endpoints rely on client-provided companyId headers without row-level DB tenancy checks.
Impact: Risk of cross-company data leakage or unauthorized status inspection in multi-tenant deployments.
Recommended_Fix: Enforce Postgres Row-Level Security (RLS) or Drizzle query wrappers that strictly bind companyId from authenticated session.
Acceptance_Criteria: Requests with spoofed companyId receive 403 Forbidden with security audit log generated.

Title: Design Token Inconsistencies & Hardcoded Styles
Observed: While token gates script exists, several onboarding and interactive thread components still use ad-hoc Tailwind/inline utility styles.
Impact: Visual jarring in dark mode, inconsistent component contrast, higher styling regression risk.
Recommended_Fix: Refactor all component styles to use CSS custom properties defined in ui/src/index.css; enforce token-gates in CI.
Acceptance_Criteria: 'pnpm check:token-gates' passes with 0 violations across all ui/src/components/.

Title: High Test Execution Overhead & Monolithic Integration Files
Observed: Single test file exceeds 67,000 lines, causing extreme memory pressure in Vitest and IDE lag.
Impact: Developers bypass running full tests locally; CI cycle times degrade substantially.
Recommended_Fix: Split integration test files by domain scenario (lifecycle, recovery, thread-dispatch, attachments).
Acceptance_Criteria: No single test file exceeds 1,500 lines; parallel vitest workers run in <45s.

Title: Absence of Semantic Prompt Caching in Adapter Layer
Observed: Repetitive system prompt frames and full conversation history are re-sent on every agent turn without prompt caching headers.
Impact: 40-60% redundant token consumption on long-lived issue threads when using Claude/GPT-4o.
Recommended_Fix: Enable Anthropic Prompt Caching and OpenAI prefix caching headers in adapter request payloads.
Acceptance_Criteria: Cache read input token metrics reported in run.resultJson showing >50% token cost reduction.

Title: Native Backup Script Lacks Remote Object Storage Sync
Observed: Automated backups are stored exclusively on local disk (maxAgeHours: 26, local retention).
Impact: Single-point-of-failure; disk corruption or machine failure leads to total database loss.
Recommended_Fix: Add optional S3/GCS/R2 streaming backup target with AES-256 client-side encryption.
Acceptance_Criteria: Backup service successfully uploads encrypted archive to S3-compatible bucket and verifies checksum.
